body:
Hi there, 

I'm often wanting to use a combination of luminance only curves, and something more generic such as "standard" or "film-like". I do have a Luminance only curve as a CTL script that does the job, however miss not having the modifier to be able to select on the image and create a curve point with the CTRL key, or having visual feedback within the UI.

Ryan :)
title: Slider to blend between curves affecting RGB or only luminance, or being able to use multiple curves with different modes.
